# EduLog v2.0.0-alpha.5

This prerelease adds custom teaching roles and a rebuilt teacher management page, lets classroom- and class-scoped teachers work in their own scope, removes unused edge functions, routes and database objects, and closes the open GitHub and SonarCloud security findings since v2.0.0-alpha.4.

## Highlights

- Custom teaching roles: teaching managers can create, rename and delete them. The system settings tab now opens for teaching managers and shows only the sections each person can use. A role that is still assigned cannot be deleted (`409 RBAC_ROLE_IN_USE`).
- Teacher management is a searchable list with a detail pane: contact details (with contact-detail access), account link, notes, class and role assignments, archive/restore and permanent delete.
- Teachers whose teaching role is granted only for a classroom or a class session can open that scope's pages and save its reports. Before, they got 403 on most pages.
- When an AI provider's model list cannot be loaded, the picker shows the reason (`auth_failed`, `not_found`, `timeout` and so on) with the provider's message, with key-like strings redacted.

## Security

- Removed the eight unused Supabase edge functions. Four of them checked only that a token existed and then read with the service-role key, so any signed-in user could read data outside their scope.
- Patched dependency advisories in the API (`proxy-addr`, `body-parser`, `zod`, `qs`, `source-map-js`, `tinypool`, `vitest`) and frontend tooling (`fast-uri`, `serialize-javascript`). `vitest` moved from 3.x to 4.x because 3.x has no fix.
- The release workflow no longer restores an npm cache before building, and release tooling no longer takes output paths from the command line.
- Password fields are announced by their visible labels instead of their placeholder text.
- Dependabot now opens weekly grouped updates against `develop`. Secret scanning and push protection are enabled.

## Behaviour changes to note

- Removed API routes with no remaining callers, including `/api/rpc`, `GET`/`PATCH /api/permissions/:permissionId/policies`, `GET`/`PUT /api/roles/:id/parent`, `GET /api/rbac/effective-permissions`, and `PATCH` on system and teaching role assignments. Role policy settings now save through `/api/roles/:id/permissions`.
- The gateway no longer serves `/functions/v1` or `/api/v1`, and the frontend's legacy API mode (`VITE_API_V1_MODE`, `VITE_LEGACY_API_BASE_URL`) is gone; the app always calls `/api`.
- The archived teaching-workspace model is dropped (`teachings`, `teaching_members` and their archives). Its helpers are replaced by scope-based ones that take no teaching ID.
- A production API now stops at startup, not on the first request, when `EDULOG_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (`API_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`) is empty.

## Images and deployment prerequisites

- Frontend: `ghcr.io/kenny1203520/edulog:2.0.0-alpha.5`
- API: `ghcr.io/kenny1203520/edulog-api:2.0.0-alpha.5`
- Alpha images do not update `latest`, `2`, or `2.0`. Use matching explicit versions for both services.
- This release does not deploy or migrate the existing production environment.
- Back up the database, then apply every unapplied migration in filename order through `1000159_teacher_archive.sql` (alpha.4 ended at 1000155):
  - `1000156_drop_unused_legacy_objects.sql` and `1000157_drop_teaching_workspace_model.sql` drop objects with `RESTRICT`. If anything still depends on them, the migration fails instead of cascading. They cannot be reversed; restore the backup to go back.
  - `1000158_scoped_teaching_access.sql` adds scope-aware permission checks.
  - `1000159_teacher_archive.sql` adds teacher archiving.
- Remove the edge-function settings `FUNCTIONS_VERIFY_JWT` and `EDULOG_FUNCTIONS_ENVIRONMENT`, and any custom proxy routes to `/functions/v1` or `/api/v1`. The bundled Kong, Envoy, Nginx and Caddy configurations no longer route these paths.
- Returning to an older image does not reverse schema migrations. Verify restoration against a backup before planning a downgrade.

## Known limitations and follow-up

- Alpha evaluation release; the final 2.0 feature set is still being completed.
- OAuth callback routes and a Storage proxy remain unavailable.
- Before beta or 2.0.0, the migration chain will be consolidated into a few files that the database applies and checks at startup. Until then, SonarCloud skips `supabase/migrations/**` for duplication only.
- Track remaining work and promotion criteria in `docs/deployment/alpha-roadmap.md`.

## Verification

- Frontend: 703 tests passed (1 skipped); `vue-tsc -b` and the production build passed.
- API: 492 tests passed; typecheck and build passed.
- Extension: 470 unit tests and the Chrome and Edge browser checks passed.
- CodeQL: no open alerts on `develop`. SonarCloud quality gate passed for the release changes against `master` (security and reliability A, 1.4% duplication on new code).
- The full CI, database and image gates run again on the release tag.
